assignment.title: 8-Minute Close-Control Practice
assignment.note: Keep it close, touch it quick, stay in control.

drills.title: Two-Cone Drag and Push
drills.instructions:
Setup: Place the two cones one big step apart. Work in the space between them.
Drag the ball back with the sole of one foot, push it across with that foot’s inside, then take over with the other foot and reverse direction. Alternate the starting foot as you work.
Focus: Keep each touch short and the ball within one step.

drills.title: Two-Cone Turn and Return
drills.instructions:
Setup: Place the cones about 3 yards apart, leaving a clear path between them.
Dribble from one cone to the other with short touches, turn closely around it, and return. Use the left foot to guide the turn in odd-numbered rounds and the right foot in even-numbered rounds; use both feet on the approach and return.
Focus: Make the turn tight without letting the ball run away.
